## Identity & Biography
- **Name**: Aryan Ahirwar
- **Brand / Alias**: VIPHACKER.100 (founded July 2023)
- **Role**: Ethical Hacker, Cybersecurity Researcher, Vernacular Security Educator
- **Academic Degree**: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) at SAGE University, Indore
- **Location**: Shujalpur, Madhya Pradesh, India
- **Primary Mission**: Delivering comprehensive, practical, and legal cybersecurity and ethical hacking education in Hindi for Indian beginners across tier-2/3 cities.

## Technical Capabilities
- **Web Application Penetration Testing**: Burp Suite Pro, SQL Injection (SQLi), Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), OWASP Top 10, Auth bypass, CSRF/SSRF, IDOR.
- **OSINT & Reconnaissance**: Subdomain enumeration, Google dorking, SOCMINT, DNS validation, Wayback archive mining, asset footprinting.
- **Bug Bounty Hunting**: Responsible disclosure methodology, CVSS report writing, scope discipline, fuzzing.
- **Security Automation & Scripting**: Python, Bash, PowerShell, custom scanner engines, REST APIs.
- **Education & Mentorship**: Hindi-language security curriculum, YouTube masterclasses, Telegram research community.

## Notable Open-Source Repositories (VIPHACKER100)
- **ReconMaster**: Automated multi-tool reconnaissance framework for subdomain discovery and DNS mapping. (https://github.com/VIPHACKER100/ReconMaster)
- **VIPSQLi**: Safe and rapid SQL injection triage engine identifying vulnerabilities in under 30 seconds. (https://github.com/VIPHACKER100/VIPSQLi)
- **DarkWin-AATK**: Advanced automation toolkit for ethical hackers and penetration testers. (https://github.com/VIPHACKER100/DarkWin-AATK)
- **LLM-COUNCIL**: Multi-agent deliberative AI council for non-hedging security risk assessment. (https://github.com/VIPHACKER100/LLM-COUNCIL)
- **PhishShield-Engine**: Machine learning platform detecting phishing, homograph domains, and email spoofs. (https://github.com/VIPHACKER100/PhishShield-Engine)
